field_principles.asp_effect_rows: Two exact engines record every bounded ASP consequence.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time shows that the fixture builder ran.
field_principles.field_principles: Each required field states why its evidence is present.
field_principles.fixture_rows: One row freezes each source, tuple, and expected effect.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Failed gates retain their expected and observed values.
field_principles.heldout_hash_manifest: Hashes bind held outputs without placing them in prompts.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A complete prefix records a terminal result.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The fixed value states that no model inference occurs.
field_principles.isomorphism_rows: Injective renamings must preserve projected exact effects.
field_principles.label_balance_rows: Label rows prove equal positive, negative, and unknown counts.
field_principles.mutation_rows: Every replay and invalid mutation has one terminal row.
field_principles.parser_rejection_rows: Every invalid proposal retains its exact rejection reason.
field_principles.partition_rows: Seed and content hashes freeze calibration and held-out groups.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Input and checker failures stop fixture qualification.
field_principles.protocol_rows: Prompt rows expose the three-line interface without held answers.
field_principles.random_seed: One fixed seed makes partition assignment reproducible.
field_principles.relation_family_rows: Family rows prove that no relation family is absent.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A stable digest detects deterministic evidence drift.
field_principles.rows: Per-example and per-mutation rows prevent aggregate-only claims.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Pinned hashes bind the builder to qualified source tools.
field_principles.span_relation_fixture_ready_score: One requires complete balanced exact evidence.
field_principles.utf8_offset_rows: Exact byte receipts detect Unicode and boundary drift.
field_principles.verdict_class: The closed class prevents an oracle result from claiming a moat.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True states that exact code decides bounded correctness.
